parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign) WHERE c.status = 'active' RETURN c.id as campaignId, c.worldState as worldState, c.economicData as economicData, c.lastEconomicUpdate as lastUpdate

parameters.name: messages
query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) SET c.economicData = {{ JSON.stringify($json.updated_economy) }}, c.lastEconomicUpdate = '{{ $json.timestamp }}', c.economicHistory = COALESCE(c.economicHistory, []) + [{{ JSON.stringify({ simulation_id: $json.campaignId + '_' + $json.timestamp, events: $json.enriched_events, summary: $json.economic_summary }) }}] RETURN c

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, simulation_id: $json.simulation_id, events_processed: $json.economic_overview.total_events, market_condition: $json.economic_overview.market_condition, player_opportunities: $json.player_relevance.immediate_hooks, price_trends: $json.price_analysis, narrative_summary: $json.narrative_summary, next_simulation_focus: $json.next_simulation_factors.recommended_focus } }}
